blocks.zh: Topic 6：ATMP 平台技術的應用
blocks.en: Topic 6: Application of Platform Technologies in ATMPs

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解「平台技術 (platform technology)」的精確定義，並區分「製程平台」與「設備平台」的差異與監管意涵。
blocks.en: Understand the precise definition of "platform technology" and distinguish a process platform from an equipment platform, including the regulatory implications of each.

blocks.zh: 掌握各類 ATMP（AAV、pDNA、CAR-T/LV、離體細胞產品）導入平台技術的程度與適用條件，特別是 matrix PPQ 的核准要件。
blocks.en: Understand how far each ATMP type (AAV, pDNA, CAR-T/LV, ex vivo cell products) can adopt platform technology and under what conditions, particularly the requirements for an accepted matrix PPQ.

blocks.zh: 學習在偏離基準平台時所需的風險評估框架，包括上游、下游及分析方法的橋接要求。
blocks.en: Learn the risk assessment framework needed when departing from the baseline platform, including bridging requirements for upstream, downstream and analytical methods.

blocks.zh: 了解平台共用控制策略與個別產品 BLA 申請之間的關係，以及 CDMO 在平台治理上的實務考量。
blocks.en: Understand the relationship between a shared platform control strategy and individual product BLAs, and the practical considerations for CDMOs in platform governance.

blocks.zh: Q 6.1 — How can platform technologies be used to improve quality and efficiency in the development of ATMP products? Q 6.1 — 平台技術如何用於提升 ATMP 產品開發中的品質與效率？
blocks.en: Q 6.1 — How can platform technologies be used to improve quality and efficiency in the development of ATMP products?

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：製程平台 vs. 設備平台
blocks.en: Core Concept: Process Platform vs. Equipment Platform

blocks.zh: 製程平台 (Process Platform)：指一套標準化的模型製程，包含相同的 unit operations（單元操作）、製程控制邏輯（process backbone），以及一致的分析方法。每個新產品只需針對特定生物實體（例如不同血清型 serotype 或不同基因 gene of interest, GOI）進行最小化的參數調整，而不必從頭設計製程。這是 PtC-11 在本節中所強調的「真正的平台」。
blocks.en: Process Platform: A standardized model process with the same unit operations, the same process control logic (process backbone) and consistent analytical methods. For each new product, only minimal parameter adjustments are needed for the specific biological entity (for example, a different serotype or gene of interest, GOI), so the process does not have to be designed from scratch. This is the "true platform" that PtC-11 emphasizes in this section.

blocks.zh: 設備平台 (Equipment Platform)：僅指特定設備或設備組合的標準化（例如相同品牌的生物反應器或層析系統）。文件明確指出：設備相同不等於製程相同。設備平台可協助簡化確效（validation）與控制策略，但其帶來的監管效率遠不及製程平台。
blocks.en: Equipment Platform: Standardization of specific equipment or equipment sets only (for example, the same brand of bioreactor or chromatography system). The document states explicitly that the same equipment does not mean the same process. An equipment platform can help simplify validation and the control strategy, but the regulatory efficiency it brings is far smaller than that of a process platform.

blocks.zh: 一句話區分：設備平台是「廚房一樣」，製程平台是「連食譜、步驟、品管都一樣，只換食材」。
blocks.en: In one sentence: An equipment platform is "the same kitchen"; a process platform is "the same recipe, steps and quality checks, with only the ingredients changed".

blocks.zh: 平台經濟學：成本與時程的量化優勢
blocks.en: Platform Economics: Quantified Advantages in Cost and Timeline

blocks.zh: 傳統 ATMP 新藥開發從 IND 到上市通常需要 7–10 年，而平台技術可從多個維度壓縮時間與成本：
blocks.en: Traditional ATMP drug development from IND to marketing typically takes 7–10 years; platform technology can compress time and cost in several dimensions:

blocks.zh: 研發成本：共用的 CQA 定義、風險評估框架、分析方法開發，大幅減少重複工作。
blocks.en: R&D cost: Shared CQA definitions, risk assessment frameworks and analytical method development greatly reduce duplicated work.

blocks.zh: 驗證/確效成本：矩陣式 PPQ（matrix approach）允許以更少批次完成製程效能確效（Process Performance Qualification）。
blocks.en: Validation/qualification cost: A matrix approach to PPQ allows Process Performance Qualification to be completed with fewer batches.

blocks.zh: 法規時程：已核准的先例（prior art）讓審查員熟悉平台架構，理論上可縮短審查週期。
blocks.en: Regulatory timeline: Approved prior art makes reviewers familiar with the platform architecture, which in theory can shorten the review cycle.

blocks.zh: 知識複利效應：每個新分子的數據都回饋到平台，強化整體設計空間的認識，形成正向循環。
blocks.en: Compounding knowledge: Data from each new molecule feed back into the platform, strengthening understanding of the overall design space and creating a virtuous cycle.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這不只是科學問題，更是商業競爭力：能夠向客戶提供「平台服務」的 CDMO，在招募新客戶時具有顯著優勢。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this is not only a scientific question but also one of commercial competitiveness: a CDMO that can offer clients a "platform service" has a clear advantage in winning new clients.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：平台如同標準化的餐廳廚房
blocks.en: Analogy: A Platform Is Like a Standardized Restaurant Kitchen

blocks.zh: 想像一家連鎖餐廳集團——每家分店的廚房設備、擺設、工作流程都完全相同（這是「process backbone」），主廚只需根據不同菜單換用不同食材或調整少數調味步驟（這是「targeted adjustments」）。
blocks.en: Imagine a restaurant chain in which every branch has identical kitchen equipment, layout and workflow (this is the "process backbone"); the chef only changes ingredients or adjusts a few seasoning steps for each menu (these are the "targeted adjustments").

blocks.zh: 新分店開幕時，不需要重新設計廚房、重新培訓所有流程——只需學習新菜單的差異即可。這就是平台的價值：大量重複使用，最小化差異。
blocks.en: When a new branch opens, there is no need to redesign the kitchen or retrain staff on every procedure; they only need to learn what differs in the new menu. This is the value of a platform: maximum reuse, minimum difference.

blocks.zh: 反觀非平台開發：每個新產品都要從頭設計製程、從頭做研究，等同於每次開餐廳都重新翻修廚房——費時、費錢，而且難以保證一致的品質。
blocks.en: By contrast, in non-platform development every new product requires designing the process and running the studies from scratch. It is like renovating the kitchen every time you open a restaurant: slow, expensive, and hard to keep consistent in quality.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Prior Art（先例技術）的監管戰略意義
blocks.en: Key Point: The Regulatory Strategic Significance of Prior Art

blocks.zh: 「先發者優勢」在法規申請中尤為重要。當一家公司的 AAV 平台首次被 FDA 或 EMA 核准後，後續基於同一平台的產品申請，監管機構對平台架構已具備熟悉度，審查員的問題會聚焦在「差異」而非「基礎」，從而縮短審查時間。
blocks.en: The "first-mover advantage" is especially important in regulatory filings. Once a company's AAV platform has been approved by FDA or EMA for the first time, regulators are familiar with the platform architecture when later products on the same platform are filed. Reviewers' questions focus on the "differences" rather than the "fundamentals", which shortens review time.

blocks.zh: 這正是文件中提到的「reduced time for review and approval by regulators (when prior art has already been approved)」的核心意涵。對 CDMO 而言，若能代表行業標杆客戶首先建立平台 prior art，則後續其他客戶使用相同平台時，監管路徑將更加順暢。
blocks.en: This is the core meaning of "reduced time for review and approval by regulators (when prior art has already been approved)" in the document. For a CDMO, if it can establish the platform prior art first on behalf of a benchmark industry client, the regulatory path will be smoother when other clients later use the same platform.

blocks.zh: 美國政府的 PaVe-GT（Paving the Way for Rare Disease Gene Therapies）計畫設立於 NCATS（National Center for Advancing Translational Sciences），正是政策層面對此方向的具體支持。
blocks.en: The US government's PaVe-GT (Paving the Way for Rare Disease Gene Therapies) program, set up at NCATS (National Center for Advancing Translational Sciences), is a concrete policy-level expression of support for this direction.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 如何向客戶推銷平台價值
blocks.en: Practical Application: How a CDMO Can Present Platform Value to Clients

blocks.zh: 當 CDMO 與新的基因治療客戶洽談時，若客戶的 AAV 血清型與 CDMO 既有平台匹配，可以這樣呈現平台優勢：
blocks.en: When a CDMO talks with a new gene therapy client whose AAV serotype matches the CDMO's existing platform, the platform advantages can be presented as follows:

blocks.zh: 時程縮短：核心製程設計無需從頭驗證，僅需確認特定於 GOI 的工藝調整。
blocks.en: Shorter timeline: The core process design does not need to be validated from scratch; only the GOI-specific process adjustments need to be confirmed.

blocks.zh: 成本降低：法規文件大部分可重用，PPQ 可能採用 matrix approach 以減少批次數。
blocks.en: Lower cost: Most regulatory documentation can be reused, and PPQ may use a matrix approach to reduce the number of batches.

blocks.zh: 知識保證：平台已積累多個分子的製程數據，設計空間更完善，風險更低。
blocks.en: Assured knowledge base: The platform has accumulated process data from multiple molecules, so the design space is better characterized and the risk is lower.

blocks.zh: 監管可預期性：平台元素已有先例，減少不確定性。
blocks.en: Regulatory predictability: Platform elements already have precedent, which reduces uncertainty.

blocks.zh: Q 6.2 — What types of ATMPs are most likely to benefit from the application of platform technologies? Q 6.2 — 哪些類型的 ATMP 最有可能受益於平台技術的應用？
blocks.en: Q 6.2 — What types of ATMPs are most likely to benefit from the application of platform technologies?

blocks.zh: 實務應用：向 FDA/EMA 論證 Matrix PPQ（pDNA CDMO 場景）
blocks.en: Practical Application: Justifying a Matrix PPQ to FDA/EMA (pDNA CDMO Scenario)

blocks.zh: 假設 CDMO 同時生產客戶 A 的三種 mRNA 疫苗所用的 pDNA，三種質粒共享相同骨架，僅插入片段（抗原序列）不同。如何向監管機構爭取 matrix PPQ（每個質粒少於 3 個連續批次）？
blocks.en: Suppose a CDMO produces the pDNA for three of Client A's mRNA vaccines. The three plasmids share the same backbone and differ only in the insert (antigen sequence). How can the CDMO seek a matrix PPQ (fewer than 3 consecutive batches per plasmid) from the regulators?

blocks.zh: 需同時滿足三個條件（FDA/EMA 核准先例）：
blocks.en: All three conditions must be met (precedent accepted by FDA/EMA):

blocks.zh: 相同骨架：三種 pDNA 均使用同一 backbone plasmid vector，書面確認載體骨架序列相同。
blocks.en: Same backbone: All three pDNAs use the same backbone plasmid vector, with written confirmation that the vector backbone sequence is identical.

blocks.zh: 相同 unit operations + 同一 MBR：生產流程完全一致（發酵、細胞裂解、純化），使用同一套 master batch record 僅填入不同 pDNA 識別資訊。
blocks.en: Same unit operations + same MBR: The manufacturing flow is identical (fermentation, cell lysis, purification), using one master batch record with only the pDNA identification information filled in differently.

blocks.zh: 組合於同一藥品：三種 pDNA 最終組合成單一藥品（combined in a single drug product）。
blocks.en: Combined in a single drug product: The three pDNAs are ultimately combined into one drug product.

blocks.zh: 滿足上述條件後，可向 FDA/EMA 申請：以平台 PPQ 矩陣設計替代逐一驗證，用較少批次（例如每種 pDNA 各 1 批，加上 matrix 交叉批次）來代替每種 9 個批次的傳統要求，大幅節省時間與成本。
blocks.en: Once these conditions are met, the CDMO can apply to FDA/EMA to replace individual validation with a platform PPQ matrix design, using fewer batches (for example, 1 batch per pDNA plus matrix cross-over batches) in place of the traditional requirement of 9 batches per pDNA, saving considerable time and cost.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CAR-T IND 平台申報——減少 BLA 重複的策略
blocks.en: Key Point: CAR-T IND Platform Filing - A Strategy to Reduce BLA Duplication

blocks.zh: 對於 CAR-T/LV 平台，PtC-11 描述了一個策略：在 IND 階段將 4 個以上共用骨架的載體以「平台」方式申報，其 CMC 部分（製程描述、分析方法、對照品等）在 IND 中統一撰寫，後續各個 BLA 只需引用此平台 CMC 資料，針對各自的臨床數據及特定差異（例如不同細胞表面受體編碼區、效力測試）補充即可。
blocks.en: For CAR-T/LV platforms, PtC-11 describes a strategy: at the IND stage, 4 or more vectors that share a backbone are filed as a "platform", with the CMC section (process description, analytical methods, reference materials, etc.) written once in the IND. Each subsequent BLA then only needs to reference this platform CMC information and supplement it with its own clinical data and specific differences (for example, the different cell surface receptor coding regions and the potency assay).

blocks.zh: 這樣的策略可避免在每一份 BLA 中重複撰寫相同的 CMC 內容，節省大量申報資源，同時使監管機構能夠快速定位差異所在，提升審查效率。
blocks.en: This strategy avoids rewriting the same CMC content in every BLA, saves substantial filing resources, and lets regulators quickly locate the differences, improving review efficiency.

blocks.zh: 關鍵前提：平台 CMC 的共用元素必須在 IND 階段即建立清楚的邊界與引用框架，後期才能順利延伸至 BLA。
blocks.en: Key prerequisite: The shared elements of the platform CMC must have clear boundaries and a referencing framework established at the IND stage, so that it can be extended smoothly to the BLAs later.

blocks.zh: 平台適用性比較：各類 ATMP 一覽
blocks.en: Platform Applicability Comparison: Overview of ATMP Types

blocks.zh: 此表反映了平台技術的核心邏輯：產品間相似度越高，平台投資回報率越大。
blocks.en: This table reflects the core logic of platform technology: the higher the similarity between products, the greater the return on platform investment.

blocks.zh: Q 6.3 — What are the considerations for developing and using platforms for ATMP manufacturing? Q 6.3 — 開發與使用 ATMP 製造平台的考量事項為何？
blocks.en: Q 6.3 — What are the considerations for developing and using platforms for ATMP manufacturing?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：偏離平台的風險評估清單
blocks.en: Core Concept: Risk Assessment Checklist for Departures from the Platform

blocks.zh: 任何對基準平台（baseline platform）的偏離，都必須經過正式的風險評估流程。以下是評估框架的關鍵問題：
blocks.en: Any departure from the baseline platform must go through a formal risk assessment process. The key questions of the assessment framework are:

blocks.zh: 偏離的性質：是上游（細胞培養）、下游（純化）、還是分析方法的變更？
blocks.en: Nature of the departure: Is it a change in upstream (cell culture), downstream (purification) or the analytical methods?

blocks.zh: 影響的 CQA：此偏離可能影響哪些 CQA？影響的機制是什麼？
blocks.en: CQAs affected: Which CQAs could this departure affect, and by what mechanism?

blocks.zh: 風險等級：依據影響患者安全的程度，定義是否需要重複進行基礎研究（foundational studies）。
blocks.en: Risk level: Based on the degree of impact on patient safety, define whether foundational studies need to be repeated.

blocks.zh: 所需補充研究：
blocks.en: Supplementary studies required:

blocks.zh: 上游變更 → 細胞擴增曲線、饋料策略、生產末期細胞特性、體外細胞年齡上限
blocks.en: Upstream change → cell expansion profile, feeding strategy, end-of-production cell characteristics, in vitro cell age limit

blocks.zh: 下游/純化變更 → 小規模病毒清除研究 (small-scale viral clearance)、樹脂壽命研究 (resin lifetime)
blocks.en: Downstream/purification change → small-scale viral clearance studies, resin lifetime studies

blocks.zh: 任何製程變更 → 分析方法橋接與可比性研究（參見 Topic 5）
blocks.en: Any process change → analytical method bridging and comparability studies (see Topic 5)

blocks.zh: 文件要求：所有偏離決策均需有書面的風險評估支持，不可口頭決策。
blocks.en: Documentation requirements: All decisions on departures must be supported by a written risk assessment; verbal decisions are not acceptable.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：病毒清除研究——即使是平台也不能豁免
blocks.en: Key Point: Viral Clearance Studies - Not Exempt Even for a Platform

blocks.zh: 許多人誤以為使用既有平台就可以免除所有驗證。這是危險的誤解。
blocks.en: Many people mistakenly believe that using an existing platform exempts them from all validation. This is a dangerous misconception.

blocks.zh: 病毒清除研究（viral clearance studies）和樹脂壽命研究（resin lifetime studies）是純化平台中最關鍵的安全性研究。當下游製程（purification process parameters）發生任何變更時，這些研究必須重新評估——即便只是微小的操作條件調整（例如洗脫 pH 值、鹽濃度），也可能影響病毒清除的對數降低值（log reduction value, LRV）。
blocks.en: Viral clearance studies and resin lifetime studies are the most critical safety studies in a purification platform. When any change occurs in the downstream process (purification process parameters), these studies must be re-evaluated; even a small adjustment of operating conditions (for example, elution pH or salt concentration) can affect the log reduction value (LRV) of viral clearance.

blocks.zh: 監管機構（FDA、EMA）對這類安全性研究高度敏感，申報資料若無法提供下游變更對病毒清除影響的評估，很可能收到 deficiency letter。
blocks.en: Regulators (FDA, EMA) are highly sensitive to this type of safety study. If a submission cannot provide an assessment of the effect of downstream changes on viral clearance, it is likely to receive a deficiency letter.

blocks.zh: 建議：在 CDMO 的平台治理文件中，預先定義哪些下游參數變更屬於「觸發重做」的閾值，避免臨上市前才發現需補做昂貴的病毒清除研究。
blocks.en: Recommendation: In the CDMO's platform governance document, define in advance which downstream parameter changes are the thresholds that "trigger a repeat", so that costly viral clearance studies are not found to be necessary only shortly before marketing.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 平台治理框架（何時用核心平台、何時偏離、如何記錄）
blocks.en: Practical Application: CDMO Platform Governance Framework (When to Use the Core Platform, When to Deviate, How to Document)

blocks.zh: 對於提供 AAV 或 pDNA 平台服務的 CDMO，建議建立三層治理架構：
blocks.en: For a CDMO providing AAV or pDNA platform services, a three-tier governance structure is recommended:

blocks.zh:
第一層：核心平台（Core Platform）
定義所有客戶共用的 unit operations、MBR 框架、CQA 清單、基礎研究（病毒清除、樹脂壽命等）的既有數據包。新客戶直接調用，無需重做基礎研究。
blocks.en:
Tier 1: Core Platform
The existing data package defining the unit operations, MBR framework, CQA list and foundational studies (viral clearance, resin lifetime, etc.) shared by all clients. New clients draw on it directly, with no need to repeat the foundational studies.

blocks.zh:
第二層：允許偏離（Permitted Deviations）
預先評估哪些參數可在指定範圍內調整（例如 MOI、培養溫度±1°C），並定義每種偏離所需的最少驗證工作（例如 1 批 engineering run 即可）。此層需有書面的風險評估模板供客戶使用。
blocks.en:
Tier 2: Permitted Deviations
Pre-assess which parameters can be adjusted within a specified range (for example, MOI, culture temperature ±1°C) and define the minimum validation work required for each deviation (for example, 1 engineering run is sufficient). This tier requires a written risk assessment template for clients to use.

blocks.zh:
第三層：重大變更（Major Deviations）
超出允許範圍的變更（例如更換細胞株、改變純化策略），需啟動完整的製程開發與驗證流程。此類情況不再屬於「平台服務」，應與客戶重新協商合約範圍與費用。
blocks.en:
Tier 3: Major Deviations
Changes outside the permitted range (for example, changing the cell line or the purification strategy) require a full process development and validation program. Such cases no longer count as a "platform service", and the contract scope and fees should be renegotiated with the client.

blocks.zh: 清楚的治理框架不僅有助於監管一致性，也能在商務層面保護 CDMO 免於因客戶過度客製化而承擔未預算的研究成本。
blocks.en: A clear governance framework not only supports regulatory consistency but also, commercially, protects the CDMO from bearing unbudgeted study costs caused by excessive client customization.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：平台控制策略 vs. 個別 BLA——兩者不可混淆
blocks.en: Key Point: Platform Control Strategy vs. Individual BLA - Do Not Confuse the Two

blocks.zh: PtC-11 在 Q6.3 結尾清楚指出：即使多個產品共用同一平台控制策略，每個產品仍需提交獨立的 BLA。原因在於：
blocks.en: PtC-11 states clearly at the end of Q6.3 that even when multiple products share the same platform control strategy, each product still needs to submit its own BLA. The reasons are:

blocks.zh: 各產品的臨床試驗結果（安全性、有效性數據）不可共用。
blocks.en: Clinical trial results (safety and efficacy data) cannot be shared between products.

blocks.zh: 控制策略的特定差異（例如不同 GOI 帶來的不同釋放規格）需在各自 BLA 中明確說明。
blocks.en: Product-specific differences in the control strategy (for example, different release specifications arising from different GOIs) must be explained in each BLA.

blocks.zh: 換言之，平台讓你在 CMC 層面「做一次，用多次」，但臨床數據包永遠是產品專屬的。這條界線在 BLA 申報策略規劃時必須清楚認識，避免誤將平台 CMC 引用關係與個別產品審核義務混淆。
blocks.en: In other words, a platform lets you "do it once, use it many times" at the CMC level, but the clinical data package is always product-specific. This line must be clearly recognized when planning the BLA filing strategy, so that the platform CMC referencing relationship is not confused with the review obligations of each individual product.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh:
一家 CDMO 正在評估是否對新的 AAV9 客戶使用既有的 AAV8 平台。平台之間的共同骨架（process backbone）基本一致，但血清型不同導致衣殼蛋白組成有所差異。請問：
(a) 這屬於「真正的製程平台複用」還是「設備平台複用」？
(b) 若下游純化步驟（例如親和層析樹脂）需要調整，哪些基礎研究必須重新評估？
(c) 如果 CDMO 希望向 FDA 論證不需要重做病毒清除研究，需要提供什麼樣的科學依據？
blocks.en:
A CDMO is evaluating whether to use its existing AAV8 platform for a new AAV9 client. The common process backbone of the platforms is largely the same, but the different serotype results in a different capsid protein composition. Please answer:
(a) Is this a "true process platform reuse" or an "equipment platform reuse"?
(b) If the downstream purification steps (for example, the affinity chromatography resin) need to be adjusted, which foundational studies must be re-evaluated?
(c) If the CDMO wants to argue to FDA that viral clearance studies do not need to be repeated, what scientific justification must it provide?

blocks.zh:
客戶計畫開發 3 種 mRNA 疫苗，三者使用相同 pDNA backbone 但插入不同抗原序列，最終製成組合疫苗（combined drug product）。請設計一套 matrix PPQ 方案，明確說明：
(a) 需要滿足哪三個 FDA/EMA 接受的核心條件；
(b) 最少需要幾個 PPQ 批次，如何分配；
(c) 若其中一種 pDNA 在中期更換了表達質粒的抗藥性基因（resistance gene），是否影響 matrix PPQ 的資格？
blocks.en:
A client plans to develop 3 mRNA vaccines that use the same pDNA backbone but different antigen inserts, and are finally made into a combined drug product. Design a matrix PPQ plan that states clearly:
(a) the three core conditions accepted by FDA/EMA that must be met;
(b) the minimum number of PPQ batches required and how they are allocated;
(c) whether it affects eligibility for the matrix PPQ if one of the pDNAs changes the resistance gene of the expression plasmid midway.

blocks.zh:
一家公司擁有 5 個 CAR-T 產品，均基於同一 LV 骨架但靶向不同的腫瘤抗原。公司希望利用平台 IND 策略減少 BLA 重複。請問：
(a) 平台 CMC 在 IND 中應包含哪些共用元素？
(b) 每個 BLA 中必須單獨提供哪些內容，無法藉由平台引用？
(c) 若第 3 個產品需要更改 LV 的效力測試方法，是否需要修改平台 IND？有何影響？
blocks.en:
A company has 5 CAR-T products, all based on the same LV backbone but targeting different tumor antigens. The company wants to use a platform IND strategy to reduce BLA duplication. Please answer:
(a) Which shared elements should the platform CMC include in the IND?
(b) What must be provided separately in each BLA and cannot be covered by referencing the platform?
(c) If the third product needs a change to the LV potency assay, does the platform IND need to be amended? What are the consequences?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 平台定義之精確性：「製程平台」指相同 unit operations + process backbone，僅針對特定生物實體進行最小化調整；「設備平台」僅標準化設備，監管效益較低，兩者不可混用。
blocks.en: Precision in defining a platform: A "process platform" means the same unit operations + process backbone, with only minimal adjustments for the specific biological entity; an "equipment platform" standardizes equipment only and offers less regulatory benefit. The two must not be used interchangeably.

blocks.zh: 平台經濟效益：平台技術可縮短 7–10 年的開發週期，透過共用 CQA 定義、matrix PPQ、harmonized 法規文件，顯著降低研發與申報成本；PaVe-GT 計畫（NCATS）是美國政府對此方向的政策背書。
blocks.en: Platform economics: Platform technology can shorten the 7–10 year development cycle and significantly lower development and filing costs through shared CQA definitions, matrix PPQ and harmonized regulatory documents; the PaVe-GT program (NCATS) is the US government's policy endorsement of this direction.

blocks.zh: AAV 與 pDNA 平台適用性最高：FDA/EMA 已明確接受 pDNA matrix PPQ（相同骨架 + 相同 MBR + 組合藥品）；AAV 相同血清型不同 GOI 可廣泛共用平台。CAR-T/LV 可藉由平台 IND 策略減少 BLA 重複；離體細胞產品平台化程度受限於批批不同的起始原料。
blocks.en: AAV and pDNA platforms are the most applicable: FDA/EMA have clearly accepted a pDNA matrix PPQ (same backbone + same MBR + combined drug product); AAVs of the same serotype with different GOIs can broadly share a platform. CAR-T/LV can reduce BLA duplication through a platform IND strategy; the degree of platformization of ex vivo cell products is limited by starting material that differs from batch to batch.

blocks.zh: 偏離平台必須有書面風險評估：上游變更 → 重新確認細胞擴增特性；下游/純化變更 → 重新評估病毒清除與樹脂壽命研究；任何製程變更 → 分析方法橋接（Topic 5）。
blocks.en: A departure from the platform must have a written risk assessment: Upstream change → reconfirm cell expansion characteristics; downstream/purification change → re-evaluate viral clearance and resin lifetime studies; any process change → analytical method bridging (Topic 5).

blocks.zh: 平台控制策略 ≠ 共用 BLA：平台允許共用 CMC 架構，但每個產品的臨床數據包與控制策略特定差異仍必須在各自的 BLA 中完整呈現，這是不可替代的個別義務。
blocks.en: Platform control strategy ≠ shared BLA: A platform allows a shared CMC architecture, but each product's clinical data package and the specific differences in its control strategy must still be presented in full in its own BLA; this is an individual obligation that cannot be substituted.
